methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing/plans page on the accessed date; where the official page geolocated outside the USA (rendering EUR) or rendered prices client-side, the USD figures were corroborated against the provider's US compare page or a dedicated 2026 pricing source recorded as corroboration. Business-email tiers are billed per user/mailbox in USD (billingModel per_seat) with the per-seat USD price and an annual-vs-monthly note; flat per-account plans use billingModel flat, and quote-only/Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. HIPAA/BAA are noted only where a provider publicly offers a BAA, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier since they do not apply to email hosting.
